title: study-v1 development pilot run record
description: Machine-readable schema for the 16-cell study-v1 development pilot record set (tasks H4-tsbuildinfo-trap, H6-remote-error-trap, H12-remote-result-boundary-trap, H25-session-seed-boundary-trap x conditions A/B/C/D). It documents field shape and the validator-enforced consistency rules; it is not a formal result pipeline and it asserts that no pilot cell has been executed.
x-nullVsZeroPolicy: A missing measurement is null, never 0. 0 is a real measured value. The two states are never interchangeable: a token field, duration, exit code, or cost of 0 means the run measured zero, and null means the run did not measure it. Fields may not be omitted: every field in `required` must be present, with an explicit null when unknown.
x-tokenAccountingPolicy: Declared convention is `input-includes-cached` (the default when `tokenUsage.accounting` is absent): `input` is the full prompt total and already contains `cachedInput`, so totalReported = input + output and adding cachedInput again is a double count. The alternative `input-excludes-cached` requires totalReported = input + cachedInput + output. The validator rejects any record whose declared convention and numbers disagree.
x-provenancePolicy: Any record with a produced artifact (solverOutputPresent true, patchPresent true, or status success) must carry artifactRootRelative, materialManifestSha256 and taskTreeSha together. A score without provenance is never a valid run record; scores themselves belong in a separate judge packet and are rejected inside a run record.
x-retryPolicy: Every attempt is recorded, including failed originals. A retry is an additional record in the same task+condition cell with attemptKind `retry` and retryOf pointing at an existing record (recordId or `taskId/condition`). Best-of-N selection, hidden retries, deleted failed originals, and retryOf cycles are rejected. pilotComplete requires every one of the 16 cells to hold a terminal status with no unresolved retry.
x-replacementPolicy: The pilot task set, condition set, and pinned task trees are fixed. A cell whose task or condition is not in the preselected set is a task/condition replacement and is rejected; metadata fields that claim a replacement or a best-run selection are rejected outright.

tokenUsage.description: Token accounting for one attempt. null means tokens were not measured; it is not 0.

input.description: Prompt input tokens. Under the default `input-includes-cached` convention this is the full prompt total and already includes cachedInput.

cachedInput.description: Cached subset of the prompt tokens. It must never be added on top of an inclusive `input`.

totalReported.description: Total reported by the provider. `input-includes-cached` => input + output; `input-excludes-cached` => input + cachedInput + output.

accounting.description: Declared accounting convention for this record. Absent means `input-includes-cached`.

cost.description: Measured spend for one attempt. null means spend is unknown; it is not 0. An amount requires an explicit uppercase ISO 4217 currency, and the amount must not be negative.

amount.description: Non-negative measured amount; 0 is a real measured zero, null is unknown.

currency.description: Uppercase ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD. Required whenever amount is present.

record.description: One attempt in one task x condition cell. All 27 required fields must be present; unknown fields, credential-like field names, selection metadata, replacement metadata, and score fields are rejected.

recordId.description: Optional stable attempt id used as a retryOf target. Required in practice for a cell that holds more than one attempt.

schemaVersion.description: Optional record schema version; only 1 is supported.

studyId.description: Study identity. Any other value is rejected.

taskId.description: One of the four preselected development pilot tasks, pinned in paper/audit/task-annotation-v1/inventory.json. Other tasks (including the wider living benchmark) are rejected as task replacement.

condition.description: Study condition. Any other value is condition replacement.

modelRequested.description: Model/configuration requested before the run; null when unset.

modelResolved.description: Model identity actually resolved from the service. Must be null and paired with modelIdentityStatus `unverified` when identity cannot be established; never fabricated.

modelIdentityStatus.description: `verified`/`mismatch` require both modelRequested and modelResolved; a null modelResolved is only valid as `unverified`.

reasoning.description: Reasoning setting recorded before the run, e.g. `high`; null when not configured.

runKind.description: This record set is development pilot infrastructure only; formal runs use a separate pipeline.

attemptKind.description: `original` for the first attempt, `retry` for a later attempt that must declare retryOf.

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 start timestamp, or null when not measured.

endedAt.description: ISO 8601 end timestamp; must not precede startedAt.

wallDurationMs.description: Measured wall duration in whole milliseconds; 0 is measured, null is unknown. Must agree with startedAt/endedAt within a 1000 ms tolerance.

timeoutSeconds.description: Configured time budget in seconds, or null when unset. A timeout status is a budget outcome, never a reward of 0.

status.description: Terminal outcome for the attempt. `incomplete` is not terminal and blocks pilotComplete. timeout, setup-error, solver-error and judge-error must never be folded into a solver score of 0.

exitCode.description: Process exit code, or null when unavailable. 0 is a measured exit code.

artifactRootRelative.description: Repository-relative artifact directory, POSIX separators only. Absolute paths, /tmp or other temp roots, `..`, backslashes and embedded username/home paths are rejected.

materialManifestSha256.description: SHA-256 of the mounted condition material for this cell; must match the pilot plan hash for the same task+condition.

taskTreeSha.description: Git tree id of the task fixture, which must equal the pinned inventory treeSha for taskId.

runnerVersion.description: Version/commit of the runner that produced the attempt, or null when unknown.

solverOutputPresent.description: Whether a solver output artifact exists. success requires true; a task-failure needs output, a patch, or a scored judge packet as evidence.

patchPresent.description: Whether a code patch artifact exists.

judgeStatus.description: Judge state. `scored` is rejected for timeout, setup-error, solver-error and judge-error statuses.

exceptions.description: Non-empty strings describing recorded exceptions, or null when none occurred. An empty array means 'checked and none'; null means 'not recorded'.

retryOf.description: Reference to the attempt this record retries. Must resolve to an existing record in the same task+condition cell; required when attemptKind is `retry`. Retry chains must terminate at an original and must not loop.

notes.description: Free-text notes; must not carry credentials or fabricated results.

recordSet.description: A 16-cell development pilot record set. A single record file may also be stored as one record object; a set may be an array of records or an object with a `records` array. pilotComplete is true only when every one of the 16 logical cells is present with a terminal status and no unresolved retry.

studyId.description: Optional set-level study identity; must match when present.
